EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2981/2937 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and a single carbonyl near 1719 cm⁻¹ consistent with an ester/carbamate C=O. The presence of nitro-group signatures is supported by bands in the 1376–1416 cm⁻¹ region (1415 cm⁻¹; GFQ-022) and a strong deformation/wag region near 850–900 cm⁻¹ (857 and 897 cm⁻¹), plus an N–N/NO-related band around 952 cm⁻¹ typical of nitramines. These features fit an N-nitro carbamate (candidate 1) better than plain esters or non-nitro candidates.
